workNode.task: Use only ballet tracker. Upsert one ballet-release:<stable-id> epic and its implementation issues with stable external refs, acceptance references, parent and dependencies. Do not duplicate tasks in the Story/Release Map.

validationNode.task: Validate stable refs, parent links, acceptance, dependencies, no cycles or duplicates. PASS success; terminal FAIL failure. Return only a configured semantic outcome. On conclusive PASS, verify plan-accepted; on conclusive FAIL, apply the obligation invalidation implied by the outcome; every acceptance change requires evidence. Retry is bounded by maxRetries and otherwise escalates the typed outcome to the Graph Reward-MDP.

graphNodes.description: Implement exactly one ready issue per invocation.

stateContract.description: Bounded GraphEngineeringStateV1 references shared by every Graph Node in one Graph Run.

workNode.task: Call ballet tracker claim exactly once for the selected release. Prefer its in_progress issue, then ready issues by priority, created and ID. Implement only it, run checks and note evidence; never claim another issue.

validationNode.task: Close only accepted work. PASS more_work while child issues remain, otherwise success. Terminal FAIL implementation_defect, invalid_plan, or invalid_design. Return only a configured semantic outcome. On conclusive PASS, verify build-verified; on conclusive FAIL, apply the obligation invalidation implied by the outcome; every acceptance change requires evidence. Retry is bounded by maxRetries and otherwise escalates the typed outcome to the Graph Reward-MDP.

validationNode.task: PASS success. Terminal FAIL transient_deployment_error, implementation_defect, or invalid_plan. Do not deploy. Return only a configured semantic outcome.
